title: Dataset Exploration & Topological Analysis
keyQuestion: What are the structural properties, statistical distributions, and class balance of raw MNIST images before learning?
keyTakeaway: Images are spatial manifolds rather than arbitrary vector arrays; border pixels carry zero entropy, while digits are centered 20x20 boxes.

title: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) Baseline
keyQuestion: How accurately can a non-parametric instance-based algorithm classify handwritten digits without explicit parameter optimization?
keyTakeaway: Achieved a strong baseline of 97.05% with K=3 L2 distance, but incurs high test-time memory and prediction latency.

title: KNN K Hyperparameter Experiment
keyQuestion: How does varying the neighborhood parameter across discrete odd values K ∈ {1, 3, 5, 7, 9} affect generalization and noise sensitivity?
keyTakeaway: K=3 achieved optimal accuracy (97.05%). K=1 was prone to stroke noise, while K=9 caused boundary oversmoothing.

title: Logistic Regression & Linear Decision Boundaries
keyQuestion: Can linear decision boundaries in 784-dimensional space separate non-linear handwritten digits, and what do the learned weights represent?
keyTakeaway: Learned pixel-weight patterns and linear decision boundaries reach 92.56%, but cannot resolve overlapping stroke topologies without non-linearities.

title: Artificial Neural Network (Multi-Layer Perceptron)
keyQuestion: How significantly do non-linear activation functions and hidden layer feature combinations improve upon linear boundaries?
keyTakeaway: ANN (784 → 128 → 10) reaches 97.49% accuracy, but flattening 28x28 images into 1D vectors destroys 2D spatial adjacency and lacks translation invariance.

title: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
keyQuestion: How do spatial convolutions, parameter sharing, and pooling layers surpass fully connected networks on visual data?
keyTakeaway: CNN preserves 2D geometry and achieves 99.06% accuracy. Shared 3x3 kernels learn translation-invariant spatial edge and curve hierarchies.

title: CNN Error Analysis & Introspection
keyQuestion: Which digit pairs cause misclassifications in the 99.06% CNN, and are failures attributable to human ambiguity or model weakness?
keyTakeaway: Out of 10,000 test images, exactly 94 were misclassified. Ambiguity concentrates in visually similar structural pairs (4↔9, 7↔2, 3↔5).

title: Real-World Preprocessing & Distribution Shift
keyQuestion: Why does a 99% MNIST model struggle on raw uncurated user drawings, and how can upstream vision normalization resolve distribution shift?
keyTakeaway: Raw canvas drawings suffer covariate shift due to arbitrary scaling and off-center position. Implementing LeCun center-of-mass alignment restored accuracy from 85.7% to 100%.

title: Data Augmentation & Affine Invariance
keyQuestion: Does injecting random affine transformations, rotations (±10°), and translations during training improve real-world robustness?
keyTakeaway: Augmented model achieved 98.83% MNIST test accuracy (vs 99.07% original). Both scored 100% on the 35 real-world digits. Because training overhead increased without real-world gain, the original model was kept.

title: CNN Interpretability, Feature Maps & Saliency
keyQuestion: What internal features do intermediate convolutional filters detect, and which input pixels drive output class logits?
keyTakeaway: Layer 1 filters specialize in localized edge, slash, and loop detectors; Layer 2 combines these into digit-part geometries. Saliency maps confirm the model focuses on strokes rather than background.

title: Model Calibration & Expected Calibration Error
keyQuestion: Does the CNN's softmax output represent true empirical probability, and how severely does overconfidence affect modern neural networks?
keyTakeaway: On standard test data, the uncalibrated CNN exhibits an ECE of 0.2541% across 10 reliability bins. Overconfidence manifests primarily on high-ambiguity out-of-distribution inputs.

title: Temperature Scaling Post-Hoc Calibration
keyQuestion: Can a single learned temperature parameter T soften logits to reduce calibration error without altering classification accuracy?
keyTakeaway: Negative experiment: Learned T=0.8691 left accuracy unchanged at 99.07%, but worsened ECE from 0.2541% to 0.3649% and MCE from 9.85% to 16.18%. Production decision: retain original model confidence (T=1.0).

title: Transfer Learning with Pretrained ResNet-18
keyQuestion: Can visual representations learned on ImageNet (1.2M natural images) transfer effectively to classify diverse CIFAR-10 classes?
keyTakeaway: Using frozen ImageNet weights with only a newly trained linear classification head reached 64.59% accuracy, demonstrating reusable cross-domain visual primitives.

title: Fine-Tuning Strategies (Layer4 vs Full Backbone)
keyQuestion: How does selective fine-tuning of deep residual blocks (Layer 4) compare against full end-to-end backbone adaptation with a reduced learning rate?
keyTakeaway: Progressively unfreezing and adapting the pretrained backbone systematically improved performance: Frozen achieved 64.59%, Layer4 reached 77.67%, and Full Fine-Tuning produced the best result at 84.68%.

title: Model Selection & Robustness Stress-Testing
keyQuestion: Across all 14 evaluated models, which architecture achieves optimal Pareto efficiency across accuracy, latency, memory, and perturbation robustness?
keyTakeaway: Baseline CNN proved superior: 99.07% accuracy, 1.69 MB file size, ~1 ms CPU latency, and consistent noise resilience without extra runtime complexity.

title: Final AI Model Freeze & Integration
keyQuestion: How do we freeze weights, verify cryptographic integrity, benchmark latency distributions, and export an immutable production engine?
keyTakeaway: Model frozen to eval() state in models/cnn_mnist.pt (1.69 MB). Rigorous CPU latency profiling confirmed Mean 1.077 ms, P50 1.175 ms, P95 1.687 ms, and P99 1.992 ms.
